name: quicks3
description: Browse and transfer files through the QuickS3 MCP server

interface.shortDescription: Safely browse and transfer object-storage files.
interface.longDescription: Connect Codex to QuickS3 to list permitted storage connections, buckets, folders, and objects, and to create controlled upload and download transfers using delegated QuickS3 roles.
